parameter_selection: Unmodified micro_sam 1.8.14 APG defaults, copied from the pre-existing BBBC019 protocol and frozen before viewing BBBC038 predictions or metrics; no mask-based tuning.
warnings: BBBC038 contains nuclear microscopy images from heterogeneous experiments, not organ-on-chip images.
The 12-image subset is a bounded image-diversity audit, not a population estimate for all 670 images.
Selection used image dimensions and grayscale statistics only; ground-truth masks and counts were not used.
The 95% intervals resample 12 images and do not represent independent biological experiments.
The benchmark validates zero-shot nuclear instance segmentation and counting only; it does not validate cell counting on the challenge OoC images.
